raw_record.question_text:
In the transition-state structure shown in the image, calculate the total number of bonds in the structure, including single, double, and triple bonds but excluding those involving hydrogen.

Note: Disregard arrows. Consider all components present in the transition-state structure.

method.method_draft: Inspect the structure and enumerate all straight solid bond lines in the transition-state drawing. Ignore the curved arrows by instruction and ignore the unconnected CrII label unless a solid line connects it. The central junction shows four solid single-bond lines: three to iodine labels and one to hydrogen. Apply the text rule excluding bonds involving hydrogen, so discard the C–H line and count the remaining three non-hydrogen bonds.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中有一个过渡态结构，中心交叉结点用直线连接到三个碘标记 I，以及一个氢标记 H；左下方有 CrII 标签，但它没有用实线键连接到中心结构。图中还有弯曲箭头。推理：按题意忽略箭头，并且忽略未通过实线连接的 CrII。中心结构中可见四条实线单键：三条连接到 I，一条连接到 H。题目要求排除涉及氢的键，因此去掉 C–H/中心–H 那一条，剩下三个非氢键。总数为 3。
